newsitem.title: FINLAND: Konecranes says to buy all of MAN SWF.
newsitem.headline: Konecranes says to buy all of MAN SWF.

text.p: Finnish crane maker KCI Konecranes International Oy said on Monday it had sealed a deal with German group MAN GHH Logistics GmbH to buy 100 percent of MAN SWF Krantechnick GmbH for an undisclosed sum.
"Deviating from the agreement of November 1996, KCI Konecranes now acquires a 100 percent ownership of MAN SWF isntead of 60 percent as originally agreed," Konecranes said in a statement.
"The purchase price is a function of mutually accepted asset values," Konecranes said, but gave no financial details.
MAN SWF Krantechnik makes hoists, standard cranes and crane components under the SWF brand, and it has net sales of about 150 million markka and about 110 employees, Konecranes said.
KCI Konecranes has had management responsibility in the company since the beginning of this year, it said.
